evidence_signal_definitions.same_item_continuity: Every event carries the same persistent instance ID and exactly one authoritative representation.
evidence_signal_definitions.source_removed_after_detach: The hook representation is absent before held or worn authority begins.
evidence_signal_definitions.hand_contact: Named hand and garment anchors are within 0.04 m for at least three consecutive frames before transfer.
evidence_signal_definitions.sleeve_portal_crossing: The named wrist then forearm then elbow crosses the correct sleeve portal plane in order without transform jumps.
evidence_signal_definitions.shoulder_settlement: Both robe shoulder anchors remain near the matching body anchors while torso collision stays within threshold.
evidence_signal_definitions.belt_contact_and_tie: Each hand remains associated with the same named belt end through the approved crossing, loop, pull, and knot sequence.
evidence_signal_definitions.locomotion_and_clip: Foot, balance, hem, arm, and torso traces pass during the full motion with the same worn garment instance.
evidence_signal_definitions.seat_support: Pelvis approaches and remains supported by the named seat surface; the state is not inferred from an animation label.
evidence_signal_definitions.world_placement: The released robe contacts the named hook or bed support, settles, and becomes the sole world representation.
